question: Which siRNA delivery system has a particle size of 139.83 nm, and how is its release triggered?
rendered: US-EV, which is an ultrasound-engineered tumor-derived exosome (US-EV) system, has a particle size of 139.83 nm. Its release is triggered by ultrasonic stimulation.
